CheckTitle: Check if S3 buckets have default encryption (SSE) enabled or use a bucket policy to enforce it
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that S3 buckets have a default server-side encryption configuration.
Risk: Objects stored without encryption at rest may be exposed if storage media or backups are accessed.

Recommendation.Text: Configure default bucket encryption with SSE-KMS (preferably a customer managed key) or SSE-S3.

Notes: CIS AWS 3.0 2.1.1 groups S3 data-in-transit/at-rest enforcement; nimbus frameworks.yaml labels 2.1.1 'deny HTTP / encryption enforced'.
